reviews.title: Cannot select more than 50 apps to block access
reviews.text: The “Airplane mode” (what enables blocking the user from opening apps), for some reason only allows up to 50 apps… well you can select multiple categories, it makes no sense to limit up to 50 apps to block from. I paid for a lifetime and this should be an accessible feature.
Can’t change start location for free plan

reviews.title: Not good on MacOS
reviews.text:
Disclaimer: Using on MacOS.

For an app that is supposed to help me focus, I had to click a million things before starting.

I would like to keep the map visible on the screen while I work, reminding me to stay focused. And behaving like an in-flight map on the TV. But the app won’t resize to be small.

After I finished my first journey, I would have liked an easy way to start my next journey from my landing site. This way, I could travel contiguously, layover-style.

Instead, I will uninstall. Nice idea but needs a lot of improvements.

reviews.title: Deceptive pricing
reviews.text: I always rate apps that force me to make payments before trying the app the lowest rate possible. I need to try the app first before giving any money. At the beginning, this app will show a lifetime plan for $33. If you closed the price window, you will get a pop-up for 50% discount for the lifetime but it will also show that the lifetime price is $49.99.

reviews.title: why pay for subscription?
reviews.text: I got this app to help me study and focus, and when I saw the feature to be able to look out the window, I thought it was soooo cool. So I paid $20 to be able to see what’s happening on the flight, only to find out it’s the same moving picture and not even custom to the individual flight. And it wasn’t even the oremium subscription, so I just wasted $20 for a video I probably could have found in youtube, but this one is cropped and has an airplane window. If it would be personalized to each flight, this would be my favorite app ever. I just wanted to look out the window and see the ground and the ocean, not some replaying clouds in a sunset.

reviews.title: Says I’m in Paris but I’m in London!
reviews.text: Great concept but I would love to start my flights in the location I’m in (London) and not somewhere random like Paris. I’ve checked settings and the app doesn’t even ask for a location
